upstream.baselineHeadSubject: docs(changelog): drop the embedded commit-SHA citations from 0.27.0 / 0.28.0

fork.note: Converting the fork to private detached it from the upstream fork network (GitHub behavior: fork=false, parent=null after privatize). Upstream tracking continues via the 'upstream' remote; weekly sync per handout INV-S2 uses fetch/merge against https://github.com/zai-org/Synapse.git. Recorded so nobody re-derives this.

incident.title: git transport 403 'Repository is disabled' for ~2 minutes post-privatize
incident.resolution: Eventual consistency after rename + visibility change; API reported disabled:false throughout; clone succeeded on retry. No action needed for future forks beyond retrying.
